## CITY OF CORAL GABLES, FLORIDA

## RESOLUTION NO. 2024-25

A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COMMISSION CONFIRMING THE APPOINTMENT OF DONNA HEISENBOTTLE ( NOMINATED BY BOARD-AS-A-WHOLE) TO SERVE AS A MEMBER OF THE LANDMARKS ADVISORY BOARD,  FOR A TWO ( 2)  YEAR TERM WHICH BEGAN ON JUNE 1, 2023 AND CONTINUES THROUGH MAY 31, 2025.

## BE IT RESOLVED BY THE COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF CORAL GABLES:

SECTION 1. That the City Commission does hereby confirm the appointment of Donna Heisenbottle to serve as a member of the Landmarks Advisory Board.

SECTION 2. That the appointment term which began on June 1,  2023 continues through May 31, 2025.

SECTION 3.    That said Resolution shall become effective upon the date of its passage and adoption herein.

PASSED AND ADOPTED THIS THIRTEENTH DAY OF FEBRUARY,  A.D., 2024.

Moved:  Anderson /  Seconded:  Fernandez) Unanimous Voice Vote) Agenda Item:  D-7)

APPROVED:

<!-- image -->

APPROVED AS TO FORM AND LEGAL SUFFICIENCY:

<!-- image -->

CRISTINA M. SUÀREZ CITY ATTORNEY
